program_repositories.title: GDAL
program_repositories.details: Open-source translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats.

program_repositories.title: GRASS GIS
program_repositories.details: Open-source GIS for raster, vector, image processing and spatial modelling.

program_repositories.title: ESA SNAP
program_repositories.details: ESA Sentinel Application Platform engine for Earth observation data processing.

program_repositories.title: GeoServer
program_repositories.details: Open-source server for sharing geospatial data using OGC standards.

program_repositories.title: WhiteboxTools
program_repositories.details: Open-source geospatial analysis tools for GIS and remote sensing workflows.

program_repositories.title: PROJ
program_repositories.details: Cartographic projections and coordinate reference system transformation software.

program_repositories.title: QField
program_repositories.details: Field data collection and mobile GIS application built around QGIS projects.

courses.title: QGIS Training Manual
courses.details: Free official, structured lessons and practical exercises covering mapping, vector data, layouts and spatial analysis.

courses.title: NASA ARSET — Remote Sensing Training
courses.details: NASA's Applied Remote Sensing Training program provides free online and in-person training in satellite observations, sensors, remote-sensing methods and applications for disasters, land, water, health and climate. Current training listings and access requirements are on the Earthdata program page.

courses.title: Esri MOOCs
courses.details: Esri's catalog of massive open online GIS courses. Offerings and registration windows vary; check the current catalog.

courses.title: GIS Using QGIS — Level 1
courses.details: A GIS and QGIS training course listed by Egypt's National Water Research Center learning platform. Check the course page for current availability and enrollment.

courses.title: NARSS — GIS and Remote Sensing Courses
courses.details: Course catalog from Egypt's National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences. Listed topics include introductory and advanced remote sensing, GIS analysis, image processing, Geo-Python, photogrammetry, GNSS and LiDAR. The catalog marks several courses as free; check each course page for enrollment and current availability.
courses.format: Egyptian GIS and remote-sensing course catalog
courses.publisherName: National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences (NARSS)

sites.title: IDSC Egypt GIS Portal
sites.details: Arabic geospatial portal operated under Egypt's Information and Decision Support Center. Browse published data and map layers; inspect the individual item metadata, update date and license before downloading or reusing.

sites.title: Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation — Geoportal Services
sites.details: ArcGIS REST services directory associated with Egypt's Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation. It is a discovery endpoint for published map and feature services; check each service's description, layer schema, update date and reuse terms.
sites.publisherName: Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

sites.title: Arab Development Portal — Egypt Geospatial Layers
sites.details: A geospatial discovery page for Egypt that organizes map layers across population and settlements, transport and infrastructure, coastlines, landscape, climate and biodiversity. Each layer links to its own service or metadata; check its original publisher and date.

sites.title: USGS EarthExplorer
sites.details: Search and access USGS and partner Earth observation datasets. Availability, access rules and reuse terms vary by dataset.

sites.title: Copernicus Data Space Browser
sites.details: Browse and explore Copernicus Sentinel imagery and related Earth observation products.

sites.title: NASA Earthdata Search
sites.details: Discover and access NASA Earth science data across atmosphere, land, ocean and cryosphere disciplines.

sites.title: Natural Earth
sites.details: Public-domain vector and raster map datasets at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m scales.

sites.title: Humanitarian Data Exchange
sites.details: Humanitarian and development datasets from organizations around the world. Review each dataset's license and metadata.

sites.title: OpenStreetMap
sites.details: Collaborative global geographic database. Data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL); attribution and share-alike requirements apply.

sites.title: OpenTopography
sites.details: Access tools and datasets for topography, lidar and elevation research. Some services or data may require registration or have usage conditions.

sites.title: WorldPop
sites.details: Research datasets and gridded population products for population distribution and demographic analysis. Check the license of each dataset.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt Administrative Divisions — Governorates, Districts and Shiyakhas
egypt_datasets.details: Bilingual Arabic-English administrative reference for Egypt. The repository lists 27 governorates, 365 districts and 5,716 shiyakhas, with names, hierarchy and coordinates. Files are provided as JSON, NDJSON and CSV. The project identifies OCHA COD-AB / HDX as its upstream source; compare the included version and administrative definitions with official current records before legal or operational use.
egypt_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the repository; attribution is required. Review the repository citation and upstream source terms.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt Administrative Boundaries (ADM1–ADM3) — ArcGIS Feature Service
egypt_datasets.details: A public ArcGIS feature service describing three administrative boundary polygon layers named egy_Admin_BND_1, egy_Admin_BND_2 and egy_Admin_BND_3, plus governorate and district point layers. The service reports spatial reference EPSG:32636 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 36N). Inspect individual layer counts, dates and attributes before using it as a current official boundary source.
egypt_datasets.license: No clear reuse license was stated in the service record; verify permission with the publisher before redistribution.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt Governorate Boundaries — Natural Earth-based ArcGIS Layer
egypt_datasets.details: A polygon feature-service item describing Egyptian governorate boundaries. Its ArcGIS service currently lists 20 features, so do not assume it represents the latest 27-governorate administrative configuration. Check its attribute table and extent before cartographic or analytical use. The item metadata was updated on 20 April 2026.
egypt_datasets.license: No explicit reuse license is provided in the item summary; verify with the publisher.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt Main Road Network — OpenStreetMap Snapshot
egypt_datasets.details: A main-road network dataset for Egypt based on OpenStreetMap. The data page lists a zipped Shapefile and KML download. It is useful for introductory transport mapping and network workflows, but the snapshot is historical; inspect its publication date and completeness before treating it as a current national road inventory.
egypt_datasets.license: Open Database License (ODbL) / OpenStreetMap attribution and share-alike conditions as stated on the dataset page.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt CAPMAS Census 2017 — Demographic Indicators
egypt_datasets.details: A research-catalog record for demographic indicators derived from Egypt's 2017 census by CAPMAS. The record describes indicators including sex, marital status and age, with Arabic source labels retained in field aliases. Check the record for the exact administrative level, data files, access conditions and redistribution rights before use; these are 2017 census figures, not a current population estimate.
egypt_datasets.format: GIS polygon dataset / research catalog record
egypt_datasets.license: Access and reuse terms must be checked on the repository record; do not assume unrestricted redistribution.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt OpenStreetMap Country Extract — Geofabrik
egypt_datasets.details: Download portal for the Egypt-wide OpenStreetMap extract. Depending on the available file, it can contain mapped roads, buildings, places, land use, waterways and other volunteered geographic features. Coverage and completeness vary by contributor activity; check the current extract timestamp and file format before analysis.
egypt_datasets.license: Open Database License (ODbL); provide OpenStreetMap attribution and follow share-alike requirements.

egypt_datasets.title: Egypt Administrative Divisions — Direct JSON API
egypt_datasets.details: Direct JSON API for the Egypt administrative-division dataset. The project documents a complete hierarchy of governorates, districts and shiyakhas with bilingual names and coordinates; its API is described as public, CORS-enabled and usable without an API key. Use the repository for version notes and attribution, and follow the stated CC BY 4.0 license.
egypt_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the source project; attribution is required.
